opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: New Projects and Commissions up to £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections up to £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications up to £5,000; Long-Term Research up to £20,000; Research and Travel up to £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating for at least 12 months) for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications, and Long-Term Research; individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for Research and Travel grants. Not open to individuals developing their own artistic practice.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research expanding the appreciation of sculpture. Categories cover exhibitions, catalogues, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, conferences, publications, long-term research, and research/travel. Applications considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, rest of world up to £1,000; plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators, artists and researchers working on historic and contemporary sculpture; Senior Fellowships for established scholars (six weeks).
opportunities.summary: Month-long research fellowships at the Henry Moore Institute in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, using the Research Library, Archive of Sculptors' Papers and sculpture collections. Applications closed for 2026/27; next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize

amount.raw: BA dissertation £250 cash prize; MA dissertation £250 cash prize; plus Henry Moore Institute publications to the value of £50 and library/website inclusion

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BA and MA students of all disciplines at UK universities, for dissertations on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture submitted within the past academic year.
opportunities.summary: Two annual prizes for outstanding extended writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. The next round of submissions opens in autumn.
